# Gold Clean — Professional Cleaning Services in Warsaw, Poland

> Gold Clean is a professional cleaning company based in Warsaw (Warszawa), Poland, serving the Warsaw metropolitan area and nearby cities.

## About

Gold Clean provides high-quality residential and commercial cleaning services. The company specializes in thorough, detail-oriented cleaning with eco-friendly products. Available in Polish, English, Russian, and Ukrainian languages.

- **Website**: https://goldclean2026.pl
- **Phone**: +48 781 628 269
- **Location**: Warsaw (Warszawa), Poland
- **Service Area**: Warsaw and surrounding cities (Grodzisk Mazowiecki, Mysiadło, Pruszków, and more)
- **Languages**: Polish, English, Russian, Ukrainian

## Services

- **Standard Cleaning (Sprzątanie standardowe)**: Regular home cleaning from 219.99 zł — includes floor washing, dusting, kitchen and bathroom cleaning, bed making
- **Deep Cleaning (Sprzątanie generalne)**: Thorough deep cleaning from 280 zł — comprehensive cleaning of all rooms, appliances, and hard-to-reach areas
- **Kitchen Cleaning (Sprzątanie kuchni)**: Professional kitchen deep cleaning from 289 zł
- **Post-Renovation Cleaning (Sprzątanie po remoncie)**: Cleaning after construction or renovation, priced per square meter
- **Window Cleaning (Mycie okien)**: Professional window washing from 45 zł per window
- **Space Organization (Organizacja przestrzeni)**: Decluttering and organizing from 120 zł

## Additional Services

Closet cleaning, oven cleaning, refrigerator cleaning, dishwasher cleaning, microwave cleaning, kitchen cabinet cleaning, hood cleaning, balcony cleaning, glass railing cleaning, ironing, dish washing, litter box cleaning, shopping trips

## Key Features

- Online price calculator with instant quotes
- Eco-friendly and safe cleaning products
- Experienced and verified cleaning staff
- Flexible scheduling (one-time, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly)
- Equipment provided (vacuum cleaner available for additional fee)
- Service for apartments and private houses
- Payment: cash or card (BLIK)
- New client discounts available

## Booking

Clients can calculate the cost and book cleaning directly on the website at https://goldclean2026.pl. The online calculator allows selecting the type of cleaning, number of rooms and bathrooms, area size, additional services, preferred date and time.
